This is exactly the rule frozen BEFORE measurement in the D1 proposals (falsification_rule 4: 'fail-closed on unmeasured entries'; vol_level_check_declared names all 17 entries) and the veto registry docstring ('None = UNMEASURED and fails the novelty gate closed (never a pass by absence)'), and the workspace mission invariant (missing evidence is NOT_RUN, never inferred PASS).
